title: article_cid codec not validated against expected 0x71 DAG-CBOR
description: verify_entry() in group_log/verify.rs accepts any CID codec in article_cid. The project mandates DAG-CBOR (codec 0x71) for all article CIDs. An adversarial peer could supply entries with unexpected codecs that pass signature verification but fail IPFS fetch downstream. Fix: add if entry.article_cid.codec() != 0x71 { return Err(...) } in verify_entry().
